launches.description:
Tranche 1 Transport Layer A is one of six missions by the United States Space Force Space Development Agency (SDA) for the Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture (PWSA) Tranche 1 Transport Layer constellation, which will provide assured, resilient, low-latency military data and connectivity worldwide to the full range of warfighter platforms from Low Earth Orbit satellites.

launches.name: Nuri | NeonSat-2 to 6
launches.description: NeonSat-2 to 6 are part of the South Korean government's Earth observation micro-satellite constellation NeonSat (New-space Earth Observation Satellite). The NeonSat constellation is the first satellite system developed by the government using a mass-production approach for precise monitoring of the Korean Peninsula.

results.name: Starship | Starlink Group 31-1 (Starship Flight 14)
results.description:
14th test flight of the two-stage Starship launch vehicle. 3rd flight of Starship V3 and the first Starship flight to deploy satellites (a group of Starlink satellites known as Starlink Group 31-1) into stable Low Earth Orbit.

results.name: Falcon 9 Block 5 | Crew-13
results.description: SpaceX Crew-13 is the thirteenth crewed operational flight of a Crew Dragon spacecraft to the International Space Station as part of NASA's Commercial Crew Program.

results.name: Falcon 9 Block 5 | Transporter 18 (Dedicated SSO Rideshare)
results.description: Dedicated rideshare flight to a sun-synchronous orbit with dozens of small microsatellites and nanosatellites for commercial and government customers.

results.name: Falcon Heavy | NROL-97
results.description: Classified payload for the US National Reconnaissance Office.

events.name: SpaceX Crew-12 Farewell and Change of Command Ceremony
events.description: Before Crew-12 astronauts return to Earth, NASA astronaut Jessica Meir will hand over command of the International Space Station to ROSCOSMOS cosmonaut Pyotr Dubrov.

events.name: SpaceX Crew-12 Crew Dragon Undocking
events.description: The Crew-12 Crew Dragon will undock from the International Space Station, carrying four astronauts. It will then reenter the Earth's atmosphere and splashdown in the Pacific Ocean.

events.name: NG-24 Cygnus Release
events.description: The Northrop Grumman NG-24 Cygnus will be unberthed from the ISS before initiating a destructive reentry into the Earth's atmosphere taking waste along with it.
